race.comment: WITCH OF NOVEMBER (3) has a moderate winning strike-rate but performed well last time at Goulburn, finishing fourth and only 0.9 lengths from the winner at the end of 1100m. Finds a suitable assignment and can get the job done. SLAY QUEEN (6) has a moderate winning strike-rate but performed well last time at Goulburn, finishing second and only 1.2 lengths from the winner at the end of 1100m after being in contention on the turn. Suitably placed so anticipating a big run this time. DITA VON (8) finished out of the money two starts back then was beaten 3 lengths when sixth over 1100m at Gundagai two weeks ago. Beautifully placed and is sure to play a major role. GOLDEN WARRIOR (4) ran eighth at his latest appearance over 1300m at Orange, finishing 2.5 lengths from the winner. Ticks all the right boxes.
